blocks.x: Failure modes & the guards we ship
Known failure modes, engineered out at the architecture level:

items: Agent sprawl
Agent sprawl — every agent ships with a role spec, budget and owner — unregistered agents are quarantined at the queue, enforced by the platform rather than by discipline alone
Duplicated work
Duplicated work — guarded because blackboard contracts make task claims exclusive, so two agents can never own the same case
Runaway loops
Runaway loops — guarded because durable execution caps retries, tool calls and spend per run; breach trips a kill switch that pages the owner
